jobs.description: Gameloft Montréal recherche un(e) Artiste technique pour rejoindre l'équipe qui travaille sur Disney Dreamlight Valley, un jeu hybride de simulation de vie et d'aventure multiplateforme ! Il ou elle veille à répondre à toutes les attentes artistiques et de design, dans le respect des contraintes de performance et des délais de production. Principales tâches et responsabilités Pipeline et outils Superviser et tenir à jour le pipeline des ressources artistiques, et détecter les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent une version. Développer et tenir à jour des outils de création numérique qui appliquent les conventions de nomenclature, les budgets de triangles, les dispositions UV, etc. Créer et maintenir les paramètres d'importation côté moteur (modèles, compression des textures, etc.). Performance et optimisation Établir des budgets par asset (nombre de triangles, densité de texels, nombre de matériaux, etc.) par scène ou par classe d'assets, et vérifier les nouvelles soumissions d'assets par rapport à ces budgets avant que les dépassements ne s'accumulent dans tout le projet. Profiler les versions sur le matériel cible et traduire les résultats en étapes exploitables. Optimiser des assets spécifiques en cas de besoin. Shaders et matériaux Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les programmeurs graphiques pour créer et tenir à jour la bibliothèque de shaders du projet en utilisant à la fois le Shader Graph et le HLSL. Collaborer avec le Directeur artistique pour prototyper de nouveaux effets visuels et travailler avec l'équipe artistique pour les intégrer au projet. Examiner et corriger les bugs de matériaux/shaders (artefacts de profondeur et de tri, artefacts de mosaïquage, réponse PBR incorrecte, etc.). Valider les configurations de matériaux dans différentes conditions d'éclairage et sur les plateformes cibles. Normes de l'équipe artistique Rédiger et mettre à jour les sections techniques du guide artistique (conventions de nomenclature, spécifications d'exportation, formats de textures, structure des dossiers, considérations d'optimisation, etc.), qui sont cruciales pour les artistes internes et les partenaires en sous-traitance. Former les nouveaux artistes aux outils de pipeline et appliquer les normes. Assumer le triage initial de tous les problèmes d'intégration des ressources. Définir et spécifier les demandes et caractéristiques du nouveau pipeline artistique. Évaluer et recommander de nouveaux outils, plugins et mises à niveau du pipeline. --- Gameloft Montreal is looking for a Technical Artist to join the team working on Disney Dreamlight Valley, a cross-platform hybrid life-sim/adventure game! Filled with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring iconic Disney and Pixar characters, Disney Dreamlight Valley is an original Gameloft Montreal production created by a passionate team eager to welcome you! To learn more about the game: Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hdvh9ninISE Official website: https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/ Under the supervision of the technical lead, and working closely with the programming and art teams, the technical artist designs tools and develops an optimal graphics production pipeline to support their team's creation process for existing and upcoming content. They make sure to meet any artistic/design expectations, in keeping with performance constraints and production deadlines. Main Tasks and Responsibilities Pipeline & Tooling Monitor and maintain the art asset pipeline, and catch issues before they reach a build. Write and maintain DCC tools that enforce naming conventions, triangle budgets, UV layouts, etc. Author and maintain engine-side import settings (models, texture compression, etc.). Performance & Optimization Establish per-asset budgets (triangle count, texel density, material count, etc.) per scene or asset class, and audit new asset submissions against them before violations compound across the project. Profile builds on target hardware and translate the findings into actionable steps. Optimize specific assets when needed. Shaders & Materials Work closely with the Graphics Programmers to author and maintain the project shader library using both Shader Graph and HLSL. Collaborate with the Art Director to prototype new visual effects and work with the art team to integrate them in the project. Investigate and fix material/shader bugs (depth and sorting artifacts, tiling artifacts, incorrect PBR response, etc.). Validate material setups across lighting conditions and target platforms. Art Team Standards Write and maintain the Art Bible's technical sections (naming conventions, export specs, texture formats, folder structure, optimization considerations, etc.), which are critical for internal artists and outsourcing partners. Onboard new artists to pipeline tools and enforce standards. Own first-response triage for all art-to-engine issues. Scope and spec new art pipeline requests and features. Evaluate and recommend new tools, plugins, and pipeline upgrades. jobs.description: To qualify for US internships, you must be currently enrolled in a degree-seeking program with an expected graduation date after the internship/co-op ends. If you do not meet this requirement, we invite you to explore other opportunities available on our careers website. Intuit internships are 12 weeks throughout the summer. We have fixed start and end dates that are designed to work with various universities’ academic calendars. Cohort 1: Monday, May 17 - Friday, August 6, 2027 (12 weeks) Cohort 2: Monday, June 14 - Friday September 3, 2027 (12 weeks) About our Emerging Talent Program: Intuit invests in Emerging Talent because fresh perspectives strengthen our products and teams. The program is backed by a culture that values curiosity and collaboration, and you'll be supported by dedicated managers and mentors who are invested in your growth. As an intern or co-op, you'll work on meaningful projects with business impact, many centered on AI and emerging technologies, and contribute to driving decisions. You'll build skills through function-specific learning opportunities, connect with a global community of interns and co-ops through dedicated programming and social events, and get exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional work across Intuit's product ecosystem. Learn more about our Intern and Co-op Program here . About the Internship: Several of Intuit’s strategy and business operations teams are hiring MBA interns for Summer 2027 through this posting. Wherever you land, the shape of the work is the same: a defined, high-visibility strategic problem, rigorous analysis, and a recommendation delivered to senior leaders who will act on it. You’ll be a trusted member of a small team, gain exposure to senior leadership, receive mentorship from experienced leaders, and build a toolkit that accelerates your career. Our summer internships serve as a key pipeline for full-time opportunities following MBA graduation. Interns are matched to one of the following teams based on background and interest: Corporate Strategy & Development (CS&D): Shape Intuit’s company-wide and business unit growth strategy — new offerings, partnerships, and international growth. Consumer Group Business Operations: Drive strategy-to-execution clarity, accountability, and operational efficiency across the Consumer Group as it pursues Taxes Done for Everyone. Mid-Market Group — Strategy & Transformation: Accelerate Mid-Market growth strategy and operating model, spanning organic and inorganic opportunities. SMB & Business Platform — Business Operations: Rotate across BizOps pods embedded withQuickBooks product VPs, turning ambiguous business problems into decisions leadership acts on. Pricing & Monetization: Own a scoped, high-visibility analysis shaping how the QuickBooks Online platform is priced and packaged, including new AI monetization models. Responsibilities Partner with project teams, leaders, and cross-functional business partners on structured problem solving to address high-priority strategic questions. Conduct rigorous research and analysis — customer and expert interviews, market and competitive assessments, and both quantitative and qualitative analysis. Build the analytical foundation for your recommendations: financial models, business cases, scenario analyses, market sizing, and pricing or willingness-to-pay analysis, depending on team. Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans — roadmap trade-offs, operating plans, and KPIs with clear performance measurement. Synthesize complex, ambiguous inputs into a clear point of view — not just a summary of options. Create and deliver compelling, executive-ready narratives and presentations, presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders (up to VP level) by the end of the summer. Participate in team operating rhythms (staff meetings, business reviews) to see how decisions actuallyget made and tracked. Qualifications Currently enrolled in an MBA program graduating in May/June 2028 and returning to complete your second year following the internship. (An advanced quantitative or economics master’s may beconsidered for the Pricing & Monetization team.) Prior full-time work experience before business school (2+ years required; 4+ preferred for Corporate Strategy & Development), ideally in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, business operations,finance, pricing, or a similar cross-functional role at a leading company. Strong quantitative, analytical, and financial modeling skills, with creativity in problem solving andsound business judgment. Structured, hypothesis-driven problem-solving; comfort with ambiguity and complex, cross-dependentchallenges; able to move from a messy business question to a data-backed recommendation. Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills; able to state a clearpoint of view and influence executive audiences. Strong interpersonal skills; builds relationships quickly and collaborates effectively across functions andwith senior leaders in a matrixed environment. Highly skilled with modern AI tools, agents, and automation, with an instinct for where they canremove manual work from processes critical to running the business. Self-directed with a strong sense of ownership and accountability; able to operate across multiplestakeholders with limited day-to-day oversight. Open to developmental feedback, eager to learn, and a collaborative, low-ego teammate. Ability to work onsite in Mountain View a minimum of 3 days per week. Nice to Have Small business B2B, SaaS, fintech, or PLG/self-serve experience. Case interview or client-facing engagement experience. Experience designing, building, or shipping ML/AI or automation solutions that changed how a teamactually worked. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. Commercial payments are a large opportunity for Mastercard in the European region. This role will lead the growth of B2B payment acceptance solutions across Europe by partnering with major acquirers, processors, and payment service providers to develop and execute strategies that increase commercial card, virtual card, and embedded payment acceptance among business merchants. The role is responsible for identifying opportunities, influencing senior stakeholders, developing acceptance strategies, and delivering revenue growth through complex, multi-country engagements. jobs.description: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. The GenAI Spares Planning Team RMA Program Manager is the single-threaded owner for ensuring Nvidia GPU material flows correctly through the returns lifecycle across the GenAI accelerator fleet. Nvidia GPUs are among our highest-value spare parts, and as the fleet scales, spares supportability increasingly depends on the timely recovery and re-induction of RMA returns. Execution sits with cross-functional partners (HWEng, Logistics, AIS-SC, Nvidia); this role monitors that flow end-to-end, holds SLA adherence at every handoff, escalates disruptions, and drives owners to recovery — backed by the reporting mechanisms that make the program scalable. If you love being at the forefront of industry growth and development, developing and executing processes in a highly ambiguous environment, identifying information gaps and collaboration needs, and driving business strategy, then this is the spot for you. This is a high impact role offering an opportunity to drive and influence business-critical decisions impacting the long-term future of the business. Key job responsibilities - Owns monitoring SLA adherence across all Nvidia GPU components covered under RMA agreements, at key handoffs and nodes throughout the supply chain cycle. - Escalates disruptions and drives recovery plans to resolution, coordinating across HWEng, Supporting Logistics Teams, AIS-SC, Nvidia, and GenAI SPMs. - Ensures readiness of RMA programs for new Nvidia GPU components ahead of platform launches – including - Collecting AFRs from HWEng - Coordinating with SPMs to size initial seed stock pool - Raising Buffer Stock RMA submissions in Nvidia’s portal - Monitoring fulfillment of initial seed stock allocations from Nvidia - Monitors approved failure log coverage and surfaces gaps to HWEng. - Expands NVTool into a scalable mechanism that supports budget planning for GPU spares, including ongoing monitoring of actual vs. planned spend - Leads initiatives to streamline and optimize the RMA supply chain, including onboarding Nvidia to the Janus Spares Supply Model. - Monitors degrade rates post-launch to identify shortages to required target levels (considering purchased inventory and seed stock), advocating for additional seed stock supply, as needed. - Monitors and escalates stuck inventory (e.g. replaced GPUs held without logs) requiring state change back to SPARE. About the team Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional trade-offs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
Fulfilment Optimization (FO) owns the systems that decide how every Coupang order is planned, distributed, and fulfilled. Our Tier-1 services sit on the critical path of Coupang's ecommerce order flow — processing every order in real time across Korea and Taiwan. We operate multiple interconnected platform components:
-Business Engine — Core order planning and distribution orchestrator (Kotlin/Spring Boot). Runs 5 distinct pipelines (Domestic, Cross-Market, 3PL, PDD, Replan) using a hexagonal architecture with pluggable processors, pruners, and manifest-based orchestration.
-Planner Solver — Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) optimization engine (Python/CPLEX) that minimizes total fulfilment cost across inventory, capacity, network, and delivery-promise constraints with sub-second latency requirements.
-Network Manager — Manages fulfilment network topology, transportation cost, FC capacity, middle-mile logistics, and cross-FC consolidation (CFCC) across 90+ REST/gRPC endpoints.
-FO Inventory — Real-time inventory availability, allocation, SKU management, and event-driven sync across multiple upstream sources (Kafka, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis).
-WMS Fulfilment — Order distribution, inventory allocation, fulfilment centre orchestration, shipment, delivery, and outbound management (Java/Spring, 138+ domain subpackages, Drools rules engine).
-Online Simulation — Real-time simulation platform for testing planning changes against production-like order streams.
-FO Workflows — Temporal-based workflow orchestration for long-running fulfilment processes.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer who can operate across deep implementation and broad architecture. You will set the technical direction for Tier-1 fulfilment systems, write and review production code, design systems that scale under heavy ecommerce traffic, and raise the engineering bar across the organization. The engineer in this role will directly influence how millions of orders are fulfilled every day. Every architectural decision — solver latency, pruning strategy, network cost calculation, inventory allocation algorithm impacts
customer delivery promise, fulfilment cost, and operational efficiency across Coupang's entire ecommerce platform in Korea and Taiwan.
This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, real-time optimization, and ecommerce fulfilment — with direct, measurable business impact.

-Design and build scalable, reliable Tier-1 services for order planning, fulfilment optimization, inventory allocation, and network cost management — systems that process every Coupang order in real time.
-Own architecture across distributed systems involving gRPC service meshes, Kafka event pipelines, CPLEX optimization solvers, multi-layer caching (Redis, S3-backed Loadable Stores), and multi-region deployments.
-Write production code in Kotlin and Java and set the bar for correctness, performance, and operational safety across the team.
-Lead design and code reviews — identify correctness issues, scalability risks, and operational gaps in systems handling latency-sensitive order flows (sub-second solver deadlines, P99 monitoring with 3-5s alert thresholds).
-Drive reliability for mission-critical services — circuit breakers, graceful degradation (hard/soft pruners with fallback), observability, and incident prevention.
-Partner with Product, Data Science, and Operations to translate fulfilment optimization goals into technical execution — PDD rationalization, CFCC (Cross-FC Consolidation), CFlow transport planning, inventory group management, and solver model improvements.
-Mentor engineers and create durable technical mechanisms (pipeline patterns, adapter abstractions, feature flag discipline) that scale beyond individual projects

codebases

-Experience with multi-region systems — region-specific routing, data isolation, cross-border fulfilment
-Experience with resilience engineering — circuit breakers, retry strategies, load testing, capacity planning, graceful degradation patterns
-Track record of technical leadership — setting architecture direction, driving cross-team alignment, mentoring senior engineers
Preferred Qualifications
-Experience in ecommerce, fulfilment, supply chain, logistics, inventory, order management, or planning systems
-Experience with optimization systems — solvers (CPLEX, OR-Tools), decision engines, constraint programming, or data-science-integrated production systems
-Experience with Agentic AI tools for development and code review — using AI-assisted coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Devin, Claude Code) to accelerate development velocity, improve code review quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks
-Experience with Spec-Driven Development — defining system behaviour through specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger, Protocol Buffers, API-first design, contract-first development) before implementation, ensuring well-defined contracts between services

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
As a Partners Solutions Architect on Anthropic's Applied AI team, you'll be a pre-sales architect focused on building technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You'll strengthen these relationships to accelerate indirect revenue, enable partners' AI practices, and execute our long-term go-to-market strategy.

Strategic technical partnership:
Act as a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team. Bring technical expertise to help us understand the partner landscape, drive key strategic programs, and find ways to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. You'll also serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
Joint solution development:
Work with partners to identify high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions, and codify reference architectures and best practices that speed time to deployment.
Customer deal support:
Step in to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
Partner ecosystem and events:
Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
Product feedback:
Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns. Deliver it to the relevant Anthropic teams to inform the product roadmap and partner strategy.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the Role
Anthropic's enterprise business is growing fast, and enterprises are adopting Claude across product surfaces. Before they can deploy at scale, they need the same foundations everywhere: security and compliance controls, identity and access management, data governance, admin controls, and cost and spend management. This work is especially critical for customers in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector), whose security, privacy, and resilience requirements set the bar for everyone else.
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to partner with the teams that own these enterprise foundations, own the planning and execution rhythm that gets each capability onto every surface, and contribute to a coherent leadership view of coverage, gaps, and progress across products. This is a senior role: product, engineering, and GTM leaders will look to you for where we stand on enterprise readiness and for the plan to close the gaps.
Responsibilities
Run the planning and operating cadence for the foundational-capability roadmap across surfaces: clear DRIs, sequenced dependencies, and a single source of truth on coverage and status for product, engineering, and GTM leadership
Drive the highest-priority foundational capability programs end to end, from scoping and tradeoff decisions through delivery on every surface
Shape the readiness bar for new products and features: what a surface must have in place before it reaches enterprise customers, and the call on in-flight features that are missing controls
Work across teams and directly with customers: partner with sales, customer success, solutions, and support on active deals and escalations, join customer security and compliance reviews, and bring what enterprises are blocked on back to product and engineering
Translate customer and regulatory requirements into technical programs: work with legal, compliance, and GTM to prioritize the highest-impact enterprise asks and map them to roadmaps with dates
Sample projects include
Take a regulated customer's security control assessment from findings to closed gaps, with owners and dates across product, security, and infrastructure
Stand up a data residency program: gather requirements by market, what each surface must support, and sequencing with infrastructure
Build the operating model for co-building with a large enterprise design partner: staffing, cadence, and how their asks reach the roadmap
Extend healthcare compliance coverage to new product surfaces, with a migration path customers can actually take
You may be a good fit if you
Have 8+ years of technical program management experience, with a track record of building cross-functional programs from scratch in ambiguous environments
Have driven decisions among senior leaders with competing priorities, and are comfortable plainly articulating what is and is not ready for enterprise customers
Have driven adoption of platform or horizontal capabilities across product teams that don't share a reporting line, where success depended on other teams building on what you shipped
Understand what enterprises require before they adopt at scale, particularly for customers in regulated industries: security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP), identity and access (SSO, SCIM, RBAC), data governance (retention, residency, customer-managed keys), audit logging, and spend controls
Have worked directly with regulated customers on their security reviews, questionnaires, audit findings, and contract redlines, and understand how control design, evidence collection, and engineering delivery fit together
Thrive when the operating model itself is still being defined and see shaping it as part of the job
Strong candidates may also have
Owned a HIPAA program end to end at a software company, including BAAs, PHI handling, and supporting product controls
Worked with financial services customers on data retention, data residency, and encryption requirements (including retention and deletion commitments, regional hosting, customer-managed keys, and contractual evidence and attestations)

Your safety matters to us.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Role Overview
Coupang is seeking a highly technical and execution-focused Staff Technical Program Manager to lead Engineering Controls, Operational Governance, IT SOX Compliance, Security, Privacy and Technology Risk initiatives across Coupang's technology ecosystem.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, operational excellence, compliance, and AI-enabled governance. The primary focus is ownership of IT SOX Change Management controls and serving as a Second Line of Defense (2LOD) partner to engineering teams by independently assessing control effectiveness, monitoring software deployment activities, identifying compliance risks, and driving scalable engineering controls.
As Coupang continues to evolve its engineering platform, this role will help modernize compliance through automation, analytics, engineering telemetry, and AI-driven monitoring. The TPM will build a control environment that improves risk visibility, audit readiness, and operational excellence while minimizing compliance friction for engineering teams.
Unlike traditional audit or compliance roles, this position requires deep expertise in modern software development, CI/CD, release management, cloud-native architectures, deployment automation, and engineering operations. Own the strategy, governance framework, and roadmap for IT SOX Change Management controls across Coupang's software development lifecycle.
Evaluate release processes, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments to ensure compliance requirements are consistently met.
Perform independent monitoring and oversight of deployment activities using engineering and compliance data.

Establish and improve controls related to:
Code Reviews
Release Approvals
Segregation of Duties (SoD)
Emergency Changes
Production Deployments
Change Monitoring and Reporting
Leverage AI, analytics, and deployment telemetry to identify elevated-risk changes, anomalous deployment patterns, and control exceptions.
Provide guidance to engineering teams and drive remediation of identified risks and control gaps.
Balance engineering velocity with effective risk management through automation and scalable controls.
Drive CI/CD Governance & Engineering Controls
Partner with Platform Engineering teams to embed preventive and detective controls directly into software delivery workflows.
Improve governance across CI/CD, release management, deployment authorization, and production change processes.
Define control observability frameworks that provide real-time visibility into software delivery controls.
Partner with Platform and Data teams to develop automated monitoring capabilities that detect unauthorized changes, control bypasses, deployment anomalies, and emerging risks.
Establish key control and risk indicators that proactively surface compliance concerns.
Design monitoring and reporting solutions for:
Release Compliance
Deployment Risk
Control Effectiveness
SoD Violations
Emergency Changes
Change Failure Trends
Develop metrics and dashboards that provide visibility into compliance, operational performance, and risk posture.
Promote automation-first approaches to evidence generation, control testing, and compliance assurance.
Security, Privacy & Technology Risk
Partner with Security, Privacy, and Risk organizations to align engineering controls with enterprise requirements and regulatory obligations.
Support technology risk assessments, regulatory reviews, and remediation programs.
Drive consistent implementation of security, privacy, and risk controls across engineering organizations.
Promote secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles within software delivery processes.

jobs.description: À Allstate, de grandes choses se produisent lorsque les membres de notre personnel unissent leurs forces pour protéger les familles et leurs biens des incertitudes de la vie. Et depuis plus de 90 ans, notre sens de l’innovation nous a permis de devancer l’évolution des besoins de notre clientèle. De la défense des ceintures de sécurité, des coussins gonflables et des lois sur les permis de conduire, Allstate est devenue un chef de file de l’industrie en matière de sophistication des prix, de télématique et, plus récemment, de protection des appareils et de l’identité. Description du poste En tant qu’agent(e) des ventes Allstate, vous développerez votre propre portefeuille de clients, tisserez des liens solides au sein de votre communauté et aiderez les gens à protéger ce qui compte le plus pour eux. Il s’agit d’un poste hybride : vous travaillerez sur place, mais vous bénéficierez également d’un mode de travail flexible adapté aux besoins de l’entreprise. Si vous êtes une personne compétitive, axée sur la production de résultats en vente et motivée par un potentiel de revenus illimité, voici l’occasion rêvée de développer votre propre activité avec le soutien d’une marque nationale. Comment vous apporterez votre contribution Tout en renforçant votre présence dans la communauté, vous accompagnerez vos clients alors qu’ils prendront d’importantes décisions en matière d’assurance grâce à des conseils personnalisés qui leur permettront d’obtenir les protections dont ils ont besoin. Vous bénéficierez d’un accompagnement personnalisé, d’occasions de développement professionnel et de l’appui d’une équipe qui vous aide à réussir pour approfondir vos compétences et faire prospérer vos affaires. En quoi consiste le métier d’agent(e) des ventes Allstate? Développer et gérer un bassin de clients potentiels grâce à des activités de prospection, à des recommandations et à un engagement au sein de la communauté. Rencontrer des clients potentiels, cerner leurs besoins et recourir à la vente consultative pour les orienter vers les solutions d’assurance adaptées. S’impliquer activement au sein de la communauté en participant à des événements et en nouant des partenariats avec des organismes communautaires. Mener des activités de vente régulières afin d’atteindre les objectifs mensuels et trimestriels. Entretenir des relations qui assurent la longévité des contrats établis et un afflux régulier de recommandations. Quels sont les avantages pour vous? Il s’agit d’un poste rémunéré à la commission. Vos revenus reflètent vos résultats de vente. Vos revenus augmentent proportionnellement à vos résultats de ventes, les revenus moyens se situant entre 70 000 $ et 120 000 $ par année . Vous aurez des commissions concurrentielles illimitées, assorties de primes trimestrielles, ainsi qu’une allocation mensuelle destinée à vous soutenir pendant les périodes où le volume des commissions est plus faible. Les avantages sociaux flexibles prennent effet dès le premier jour travaillé et les contributions de l’employeur au titre du REER débutent après 90 jours seulement. Vous profiterez d’un soutien relativement à l’obtention du permis, du coaching et d’un développement continu en vente pour accompagner votre croissance à long terme. Ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir dans ce poste Un état d’esprit axé sur les résultats et les objectifs, avec une expérience avérée dans la réalisation des cibles de vente. De l’expérience dans le développement de votre propre bassin de clients potentiels, dans la croissance de votre réseau et dans l’établissement de votre présence au sein de la communauté. De solides compétences en communication et en gestion des relations, ainsi que la capacité à instaurer rapidement un climat de confiance. De l’aisance dans la prospection et la génération de pistes de vente. Être en mesure d’obtenir un permis (ou être déjà titulaire d’un permis) autorisant la vente d’assurances dans votre province. De l’expérience dans la vente dans le secteur des assurances ou dans un autre domaine axé sur la relation client. Ce poste est-il à pourvoir en présentiel ou à distance? Il s’agit d’un poste hybride. Vous passerez un temps précieux sur le terrain pour acquérir des compétences, rencontrer des clients et élargir votre réseau. À mesure que vous progresserez vers la réussite, la flexibilité de ce poste permettra de répondre à vos besoins pour vous aider à développer vos affaires et atteindre vos objectifs de performance. Ce que vous pouvez attendre d’Allstate Un accompagnement personnalisé, des formations en vente, une aide à l’obtention du permis et des occasions d’évolution de carrière. Une rémunération concurrentielle, des avantages sociaux, des bonis et de la reconnaissance pour les performances exceptionnelles. Un réseau solidaire de leaders et de collègues qui souhaitent votre réussite et célèbrent vos victoires. Une culture qui respecte vos atouts uniques et vous donne les moyens de développer votre activité, à votre manière. Qui s’épanouit dans ce poste? Convient à toute personne : Qui s’épanouit dans des environnements axés sur la performance avec des attentes claires. Qui est motivée par la création de relations et l’augmentation de ses revenus. Qui aime échanger avec les gens et s’impliquer dans sa communauté. Souhaite être maître de sa réussite et suivre un parcours professionnel offrant des perspectives d’évolution. Vous souhaitez postuler? Si la création de relations, le développement de vos activités professionnelles et la contribution significative à votre communauté vous motivent, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer. Le Groupe Allstate du Canada dispose de politiques et de pratiques permettant d’offrir des mesures d’adaptation en milieu de travail. Si nécessaire, nous établirons avec vous les mesures qui doivent être prises pour répondre à vos besoins. Compétences Networking, Sales, Self Motivation Rémunération Les commissions sont très variables et dépendent directement du volume des ventes. Les personnes atteignant, ou approchant, leurs objectifs de vente et ayant complété toute la formation peuvent s’attendre à un revenu compris entre 70 000$ et 120 000$ Lorsque vous vous joignez à notre équipe, vous obtenez non seulement un emploi, mais vous vous ouvrez aux possibilités. Vous aurez la chance de faire passer vos compétences au niveau supérieur. On vous encouragera à remettre en cause le statu quo. Vous aurez la possibilité de façonner l’avenir de la protection tout en soutenant les causes qui vous sont chères. Avoir un emploi dans notre équipe, c’est faire partie de quelque chose de plus grand que soi. C’est faire partie d’une équipe gagnante qui change concrètement les choses. Le Groupe Allstate du Canada utilise des outils technologiques alimentés par l’intelligence artificielle pour aider au processus de présélection, de sélection, d’évaluation et de planification des entrevues avec les candidats dans le cadre du processus de recrutement. Cet affichage de poste concerne un poste ouvert actuellement au sein de l’organisation.

jobs.description: With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger. Position Purpose: A Home Services Sales Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior and interior products and services to customers. The Sales Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Sales Consultant will spend the majority of their working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Sales Consultants will travel to customers' homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations, develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs, and maintain/drive profitability. The Sales Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry-standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Sales Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). To drive sales and increase the pipeline of potential customers, a Sales Consultant will travel to their assigned stores, maintain local relationships, educate store associates on HDIS offerings, and bring awareness to HDIS programs. Key Responsibilities: 100% - Customer Service -Travel and engage in outside sales activities, primarily in customers' homes. Conduct professional and compelling sales presentations. Adapt quickly to changing customer needs and effectively advocate HDIS solutions. Conduct incidental activities necessary to complete sales (e.g., assessing customer needs, develop price quotes, measure product specifications, etc.) Present warranty and available financing options to customers. Prepare for appointments, commute to/from appointments and process sales-related paperwork. Prospecting for new customers both inside and outside of assigned THD store and participate in scheduled industry events. Proactively seek out new referrals and develop and maintain relationships with store management and associates. Attend sales and store team meetings to continually improve sales techniques and learn about HDIS product offerings. Direct Manager/Direct Reports: This Position typically reports to the Sales Manager This position has no Direct Reports Travel Requirements: Typically requires overnight travel 5% of the time. Physical Requirements: Must continuously stand or walk or regularly requires lifting/handling/carrying material or equipment of moderate weight (8-20 pounds). Working Conditions: Usually in a comfortable environment but with regular exposure to factors causing moderate physical discomfort from such things as dust, fumes or odors. Minimum Qualifications: Must be 18 years of age or older Must be legally permitted to work in the United States Preferred Qualifications: Prior in-home or virtual sales experience Prior home improvement industry experience Prior experience with successful lead generation Computer and application skills and use of varied technology (email, iPad, apps, etc.) Minimum Education: The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED. Preferred Education: Minimal or no education requirements Minimum Years of Work Experience: 1 + years of previous related work experience Preferred Years of Work Experience: 1 + years of previous related work experience Minimum Leadership Experience: No previous leadership experience Preferred Leadership Experience: No previous leadership experience Certifications: None Competencies: Action Oriented Communicates Effectively Customer Focus Drives Results For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Nevada, New York City, Ithaca (NY), Westchester County (NY), and Washington residents: The pay range for this position is between $40,000.00 - $100,000.00
